records.real_world_identity_notes: Brazilian sports car built between 1970 and 1980 on Volkswagen running gear, with a fibreglass body, an air-cooled flat four and a four-speed manual gearbox. Despite the GTE name it is a classic road-derived car rather than a GTE-class racer, and AMS2 classes it under Copa Classic B. Its controls match that: an H-pattern shift, the clutch needed to pull away, and no automation at all.
